title: Bathymetry Voxel
description: Single depth measurement fused into the twin's progressive bathymetry grid. Each voxel accumulates evidence over time: the more soundings that fall in a cell, the higher the confidence. The voxel does not store the raw soundings; the twin's TSDF (truncated signed distance field) implementation keeps a running average and sample count per cell.

lat.description: Latitude of the cell center in decimal degrees.

lon.description: Longitude of the cell center in decimal degrees.

depth_m.description: Running average depth in meters at this cell. Positive = water depth below the surface.

confidence.description: Confidence in the depth reading, 0 to 1. Confidence is a function of sample count and recency: 1 sample = 0.1, 5 samples = 0.5, 20+ samples = 0.9. Recency decay applies: confidence drops 10% per week without a new sample.

sample_count.description: Number of soundings fused into this cell since the twin started. Grows monotonically. Used for visualization (older cells render dimmer).

last_sample_ns.description: UTC nanoseconds of the most recent sounding fused into this cell.

source.description: Source of the depth data. 'merged' when multiple sources have been fused into this cell.
